emmetCompletions.description: Enable class name completions when using Emmet-style syntax, for example `div.bg-red-500.uppercase`

includeLanguages.description: Enable features in languages that are not supported by default. Add a mapping here between the new language and an already supported language. E.g.: `{"plaintext": "html"}`

exclude.description: Configure glob patterns to exclude from all IntelliSense features. Inherits all glob patterns from the `#files.exclude#` setting.

classAttributes.description: The HTML attributes for which to provide class completions, hover previews, linting etc.

classFunctions.description: The function or tagged template literal names for which to provide class completions, hover previews, linting etc.

colorDecorators.description: Controls whether the editor should render inline color decorators for Tailwind CSS classes and helper functions.

validate.description: Enable linting. Rules can be configured individually using the `tailwindcss.lint.*` settings

cssConflict.description: Class names on the same HTML element which apply the same CSS property or properties

invalidScreen.description: Unknown screen name used with the [`@screen` directive](https://tailwindcss.com/docs/functions-and-directives/#screen)

invalidVariant.description: Unknown variant name used with the [`@variants` directive](https://tailwindcss.com/docs/functions-and-directives/#variants)

invalidConfigPath.description: Unknown or invalid path used with the [`theme` helper](https://tailwindcss.com/docs/functions-and-directives/#theme)

recommendedVariantOrder.description: Class variants not in the recommended order (applies in [JIT mode](https://tailwindcss.com/docs/just-in-time-mode) only)

usedBlocklistedClass.description: Usage of class names that have been blocklisted via `@source not inline(…)`

suggestCanonicalClasses.description: Indicate when utilities may be written in a more optimal form

configFile.description: Manually specify the Tailwind config file or files that should be read to provide IntelliSense features. Can either be a single string value, or an object where each key is a config file path and each value is a glob or array of globs representing the set of files that the config file applies to.

rootFontSize.description: Root font size in pixels. Used to convert `rem` CSS values to their `px` equivalents. See `#tailwindCSS.showPixelEquivalents#`.

inspectPort.description: Enable the Node.js inspector agent for the language server and listen on the specified port.

server.description: Traces the communication between VS Code and the Tailwind CSS Language Server.

referenceCount.description: Display reference counts above top level blocks and attributes.

enableEnhancedValidation.description: Enable enhanced validation of Terraform files and modules

path.description: Path to the Terraform Language Server binary (optional)

args.description: Arguments to pass to language server binary

port.description: Language server TCP port to connect to. This is not compatible with `#terraform.languageServer.path#`. This is used when you want the extension to connect via TCP to an already running language server process.

ignoreSingleFileWarning.description: Enable warning when opening a single Terraform file instead of a Terraform folder. Enabling this will prevent the message being sent

ignorePaths.description: Per-workspace list of paths for the language server to ignore when indexing files

ignoreDirectoryNames.description: Per-workspace list of directory names for the language server to ignore when indexing files

path.description: Path to the Terraform binary used by the Terraform Language Server

timeout.description: Overrides Terraform execution timeout (e.g. 30s) used by the Terraform Language Server

logFilePath.description: Path to a file (`TF_LOG_PATH`) for Terraform executions to be logged used by the the Terraform Language Server. Support for variables (e.g. timestamp, pid, ppid) via Go template syntax `{{varName}}`

enable.description: Enable HashiCorp Terraform MCP Server integration

validateOnSave.description: Enable validating the currently open file on save

prefillRequiredFields.description: Enable autocompletion for required fields when completing Terraform blocks. Combine with `#editor.suggest.preview#` and the editor will provide inline snippet suggestions for blocks of code

enabled.description: %extension.tinymist.config.tinymist.lint.enabled.desc%

symbol.description: Whether to make symbol completion stepless. For example, `$ar|$` will be completed to `$arrow.r$`. Hint: Restarting the editor is required to change this setting.

extends.description: Config files to inherit. The files are interpreted in order, starting with the first entry. Later entries take precedence over earlier ones, and this config takes precedence over all of them.

toml-version.description: TOML version to use if not specified in the schema and comment directive.

path.description: Specifies the folder path to the tsserver and `lib*.d.ts` files under a TypeScript install to use for IntelliSense, for example: `./node_modules/typescript/lib`. - When specified as a user setting, the TypeScript version from `js/ts.tsdk.path` automatically replaces the built-in TypeScript version.…

promptToUseWorkspaceVersion.description: Enables prompting of users to use the TypeScript version configured in the workspace for Intellisense.

useTsgo.description: Disables TypeScript and JavaScript language features to allow usage of the TypeScript Go experimental extension. Requires TypeScript Go to be installed and configured. Requires reloading extensions after changing this setting.

locale.description: Sets the locale used to report JavaScript and TypeScript errors. Defaults to use VS Code's locale.

autoDetect.description: Controls auto detection of tsc tasks.

quoteStyle.description: Preferred quote style to use for Quick Fixes.

importModuleSpecifier.description: Preferred path style for auto imports.

importModuleSpecifierEnding.description: Preferred path ending for auto imports.

jsxAttributeCompletionStyle.description: Preferred style for JSX attribute completions.

includePackageJsonAutoImports.description: Enable/disable searching `package.json` dependencies for available auto imports.

autoImportFileExcludePatterns.description: Specify glob patterns of files to exclude from auto imports. Relative paths are resolved relative to the workspace root. Patterns are evaluated using tsconfig.json [`exclude`](https://www.typescriptlang.org/tsconfig#exclude) semantics.

autoImportSpecifierExcludeRegexes.description: Specify regular expressions to exclude auto imports with matching import specifiers. preferTypeOnlyAutoImports.description: Include the `type` keyword in auto-imports whenever possible. Requires using TypeScript 5.3+ in the workspace.

useAliasesForRenames.description: Enable/disable introducing aliases for object shorthand properties during renames.

renameMatchingJsxTags.description: When on a JSX tag, try to rename the matching tag instead of renaming the symbol. Requires using TypeScript 5.1+ in the workspace.

organizeImports.description: Advanced preferences that control how imports are ordered.

caseSensitivity.description: Specifies how imports should be sorted with regards to case-sensitivity. If `auto` or unspecified, we will detect the case-sensitivity per file

typeOrder.description: Specify how type-only named imports should be sorted.

unicodeCollation.description: Specify whether to sort imports using Unicode or Ordinal collation.

locale.description: Requires `organizeImports.unicodeCollation: 'unicode'`. Overrides the locale used for collation. Specify `auto` to use the UI locale.

numericCollation.description: Requires `organizeImports.unicodeCollation: 'unicode'`. Sort numeric strings by integer value.

accentCollation.description: Requires `organizeImports.unicodeCollation: 'unicode'`. Compare characters with diacritical marks as unequal to base character.

caseFirst.description: Requires `organizeImports.unicodeCollation: 'unicode'`, and `organizeImports.caseSensitivity` is not `caseInsensitive`. Indicates whether upper-case will sort before lower-case.

enabled.description: Enable/disable the default JavaScript and TypeScript formatter.

enabled.description: Enable/disable project-wide IntelliSense on web. Requires that VS Code is running in a trusted context.

suppressSemanticErrors.description: Suppresses semantic errors on web even when project wide IntelliSense is enabled. This is always on when project wide IntelliSense is not enabled or available. See `#js/ts.tsserver.web.projectWideIntellisense.enabled#`

diagnosticDir.description: Directory where TypeScript server writes Node diagnostic output by passing `--diagnostic-dir`.

heapSnapshot.description: Controls how many near-heap-limit snapshots TypeScript server writes by passing `--heapsnapshot-near-heap-limit`. Set to `0` to disable.

heapProfile.description: Configures heap profiling for TypeScript server.

enabled.description: Enable heap profiling for TypeScript server by passing `--heap-prof`.

dir.description: Directory where TypeScript server writes heap profiles by passing `--heap-prof-dir`.

interval.description: Sampling interval in bytes for TypeScript server heap profiling by passing `--heap-prof-interval`.

watchOptions.description: Configure which watching strategies should be used to keep track of files and directories.

oneOf.description: Use VS Code's file watchers instead of TypeScript's. Requires using TypeScript 5.4+ in the workspace.

watchFile.description: Strategy for how individual files are watched.

watchDirectory.description: Strategy for how entire directory trees are watched under systems that lack recursive file-watching functionality.

fallbackPolling.description: When using file system events, this option specifies the polling strategy that gets used when the system runs out of native file watchers and/or doesn't support native file watchers.

synchronousWatchDirectory.description: Disable deferred watching on directories. Deferred watching is useful when lots of file changes might occur at once (e.g. a change in node_modules from running npm install), but you might want to disable it with this flag for some less-common setups.

enabled.description: Enables tracing TS server performance to a directory. These trace files can be used to diagnose TS Server performance issues. The log may contain file paths, source code, and other potentially sensitive information from your project.

log.description: Enables logging of the TS server to a file. This log can be used to diagnose TS Server issues. The log may contain file paths, source code, and other potentially sensitive information from your project.

pluginPaths.description: Additional paths to discover TypeScript Language Service plugins.

items.description: Either an absolute or relative path. Relative path will be resolved against workspace folder(s).

target.description: Set target JavaScript language version for emitted JavaScript and include library declarations. See more: https://www.typescriptlang.org/tsconfig#target.

checkJs.description: Enable/disable semantic checking of JavaScript files. Existing `jsconfig.json` or `tsconfig.json` files override this setting.

experimentalDecorators.description: Enable/disable `experimentalDecorators` in JavaScript files that are not part of a project. Existing `jsconfig.json` or `tsconfig.json` files override this setting.

strictNullChecks.description: Enable/disable [strict null checks](https://www.typescriptlang.org/tsconfig#strictNullChecks) in JavaScript and TypeScript files that are not part of a project. Existing `jsconfig.json` or `tsconfig.json` files override this setting.

strictFunctionTypes.description: Enable/disable [strict function types](https://www.typescriptlang.org/tsconfig#strictFunctionTypes) in JavaScript and TypeScript files that are not part of a project. Existing `jsconfig.json` or `tsconfig.json` files override this setting.

strict.description: Enable/disable [strict mode](https://www.typescriptlang.org/tsconfig#strict) in JavaScript and TypeScript files that are not part of a project. Existing `jsconfig.json` or `tsconfig.json` files override this setting.

caseFirst.description: Requires `organizeImports.unicodeCollation: 'unicode'`, and `organizeImports.caseSensitivity` is not `caseInsensitive`. Indicates whether upper-case will sort before lower-case.

insertSpaceAfterCommaDelimiter.description: Defines space handling after a comma delimiter.

insertSpaceAfterConstructor.description: Defines space handling after the constructor keyword.

insertSpaceAfterSemicolonInForStatements.description: Defines space handling after a semicolon in a for statement.

insertSpaceBeforeAndAfterBinaryOperators.description: Defines space handling after a binary operator.

insertSpaceAfterKeywordsInControlFlowSta.description: Defines space handling after keywords in a control flow statement.

insertSpaceAfterFunctionKeywordForAnonym.description: Defines space handling after function keyword for anonymous functions.

insertSpaceBeforeFunctionParenthesis.description: Defines space handling before function argument parentheses.

insertSpaceAfterOpeningAndBeforeClosingN.description: Defines space handling after opening and before closing non-empty parenthesis.
Defines space handling after opening and before closing non-empty brackets.
Defines space handling after opening and before closing non-empty braces.

insertSpaceAfterOpeningAndBeforeClosingE.description: Defines space handling after opening and before closing empty braces.

insertSpaceAfterOpeningAndBeforeClosingT.description: Defines space handling after opening and before closing template string braces.

insertSpaceAfterOpeningAndBeforeClosingJ.description: Defines space handling after opening and before closing JSX expression braces.

placeOpenBraceOnNewLineForFunctions.description: Defines whether an open brace is put onto a new line for functions or not.

placeOpenBraceOnNewLineForControlBlocks.description: Defines whether an open brace is put onto a new line for control blocks or not.

indentSwitchCase.description: Indent case clauses in switch statements. Requires using TypeScript 5.1+ in the workspace.

enabled.description: Enable/disable suggestion diagnostics for JavaScript files in the editor.
Enable/disable automatic updating of import paths when you rename or move a file in VS Code.

autoClosingTags.description: Enable/disable automatic closing of JSX tags.

preferGoToSourceDefinition.description: Makes `Go to Definition` avoid type declaration files when possible by triggering `Go to Source Definition` instead. This allows `Go to Source Definition` to be triggered with the mouse gesture.

enabled.description: Automatically update imports when pasting code. Requires TypeScript 5.6+.
Enable/disable autocomplete suggestions.

names.description: Enable/disable including unique names from the file in JavaScript suggestions. Note that name suggestions are always disabled in JavaScript code that is semantically checked using `@ts-check` or `checkJs`.

completeFunctionCalls.description: Complete functions with their parameter signature.

paths.description: Enable/disable suggestions for paths in import statements and require calls.

completeJSDocs.description: Enable/disable suggestion to complete JSDoc comments.

generateReturns.description: Enable/disable generating `@returns` annotations for JSDoc templates.

includeAutomaticOptionalChainCompletions.description: Enable/disable showing completions on potentially undefined values that insert an optional chain call. Requires strict null checks to be enabled.

includeCompletionsForImportStatements.description: Enable/disable auto-import-style completions on partially-typed import statements.

enabled.description: Enable/disable snippet completions for class members.
Enable/disable references CodeLens in JavaScript and TypeScript files. This CodeLens shows the number of references for classes and exported functions and allows you to peek or navigate to them.

showOnAllFunctions.description: Enable/disable the [references CodeLens](#js/ts.referencesCodeLens.enabled) on all functions in JavaScript and TypeScript files.

enabled.description: Enable/disable inlay hints for parameter names: ```typescript parseInt(/* str: */ '123', /* radix: */ 8) ```

suppressWhenArgumentMatchesName.description: Suppress parameter name hints on arguments whose text is identical to the parameter name.

enabled.description: Enable/disable inlay hints for implicit parameter types: ```typescript el.addEventListener('click', e /* :MouseEvent */ => ...) ```
Enable/disable inlay hints for implicit variable types: ```typescript const foo /* :number */ = Date.now(); ```

suppressWhenTypeMatchesName.description: Suppress type hints on variables whose name is identical to the type name.

enabled.description: Enable/disable inlay hints for implicit types on property declarations: ```typescript class Foo { prop /* :number */ = Date.now(); } ```
Enable/disable inlay hints for implicit return types on function signatures: ```typescript function foo() /* :number */ { return Date.now(); } ```

exportPdf.description: The extension can export PDFs of your Typst files. This setting controls whether this feature is enabled and how often it runs.

rootPath.description: Configure the root for absolute paths in typst

semanticTokens.description: Enable or disable semantic tokens (LSP syntax highlighting)

serverPath.description: The extension can use a local typst-lsp executable instead of the one bundled with the extension. This setting controls the path to the executable.

server.description: Traces the communication between VS Code and the language server.

experimentalFormatterMode.description: The extension can format Typst files using typstfmt (experimental).
